title: Latent Residual Reasoning for Ranking in Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.36890v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) models for ranking typically adopt a fast-thinking direct prediction paradigm with strong practical efficiency. However, ranking requires fine-grained scoring across multiple candidate items, while existing GR models still mainly rely on one-shot prediction. This raises the question whether additional inference-time computation can further improve ranking quality. Recently, inspired by Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning in large language models (LLMs), some work has begun to introduce reasoning into recommendation systems. Some of these methods rely on LLM reasoning frameworks to perform explicit reasoning in textual space, but such designs are not suitable for more widely deployed non-textual recommendation models. translated_title: 生成式推荐排序中的潜在残差推理
translated_abstract: 面向排序的生成式推荐（GR）模型通常采用具有很强实际效率的“快思考”直接预测范式。然而，排序需要对多个候选物品进行细粒度打分，而现有GR模型仍主要依赖一次性预测。这引出了一个问题：额外的推理时计算能否进一步提升排序质量。最近，受大语言模型（LLM）中思维链（CoT）推理的启发，一些工作开始将推理引入推荐系统。其中部分方法依赖LLM推理框架在文本空间中执行显式推理，但这类设计并不适用于部署更为广泛的非文本推荐模型。一个更相关的方向是将潜在推理引入基于ID的推荐模型。尽管近期工作已将潜在推理扩展到工业级排序场景，但如何使连续的推理步骤（摘要在此处截断，后续内容缺失）
tldr: 该论文提出在生成式推荐排序中引入潜在残差推理，使基于ID的非文本推荐模型能够在推理时通过多步潜在计算提升对多候选物品的细粒度排序质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes latent residual reasoning for ranking in generative recommendation, enabling ID-based non-textual recommendation models to improve fine-grained ranking quality over multiple candidates through multi-step latent computation at inference time.
